skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Sun Slant
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sun Slant. After sorting through his attic, Diamante finally pieced together a web connecting the nobles to the mining accident twenty years ago. As he rubs his aching neck, the sunlight seeps in through the window.
skins.quote: Now that everything has been laid bare and the plan has run through his mind countless times, he knows what he must do next.
